subject: Clarify hosting partner swap and EU SFTP exception for AlphaMed pilot
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@alphamed.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@alphamed.com
Date: 2027-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor list + temporary EU SFTP exception for pilot

Hi Jonas,

Quick intro — I'm Alice (Infosec at AlphaMed). We're moving forward with a short pilot and hearing that Redwood plans to onboard a new hosting/edge partner next week. Before we sign off we need:

- Full current subprocessor inventory (who will touch logs/telemetry for EU-hosted traffic).
- Confirmation whether you can support an exception to deliver logs to our EU SFTP endpoint managed by our partner (we require EU residency for raw logs for the pilot).
- Encryption details (in-transit & at-rest) and whether any of the listed subprocessors will transfer raw log files outside the EU.

Can you send the inventory and a short note on the SFTP exception process today? We'll need the legal/MAP language to sign.

Thanks,

Alice Chen
Information Security Manager
AlphaMed
[Attachment: alpha-pilot-scope.pdf (pdf, 28KB)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-10-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Subprocessor list + temporary EU SFTP exception for pilot

FYI — forwarding Alice's note from AlphaMed. They specifically want a temporary exception to send raw logs to an EU SFTP endpoint operated by their partner. Legal will want a clear temporary carve-out and a short MAP/POA.

I've attached our current subprocessor inventory (latest from inventory owner). Next steps:

- Kimberly: can you confirm which subprocessors will see raw logs for EU traffic and whether EdgeBridge Ltd (the intended edge partner) can be constrained to EU-only storage for the pilot?
- Marissa: please prep a one-page DPA addendum draft and a 30-day Mutual Action Plan with acceptance criteria.

I'll loop legal if we need to escalate. Tagging timelines: customer wants to start pilot next Monday (2027-10-16).

Thanks,

Jonas
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 56KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@alphamed.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-10-09T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor list + temporary EU SFTP exception for pilot

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers below; attaching the inventory we sent internally.

- Subprocessors touching EU raw logs: EdgeBridge Ltd (edge SFTP/cache), LogSight GmbH (log ingestion), and CloudKey KMS (key management). See attached inventory for versions and regions.
- EU SFTP exception: We can support delivering raw logs to your EU SFTP endpoint under a time-limited exception (up to 30 days) provided:
  * The SFTP endpoint is managed by a vetted partner and reachable only over TLS and key-based auth
  * Data is stored in EU-only buckets and access is limited to named principals
  * We have a signed DPA addendum and a short operating playbook (access and rotation rules)
- Encryption: In-transit: TLS 1.2+ for all transfers; SFTP with key auth. At-rest: AES-256 with customer-specific keys stored in CloudKey KMS; key export is not permitted.
- Cross-border transfers: During the pilot, EdgeBridge Ltd will not export raw logs outside the EU. Anonymized telemetry (latency metrics) may be aggregated in the US for analytics; we will provide a mapping of fields.

Next steps: I'll circulate the 1-page DPA addendum and the MAP (Marissa is drafting). Could you confirm the SFTP hostname, contact for key setup, and whether AlphaMed requires an on-prem connector or just hosted SFTP? Also confirm PO/process for temporary exceptions.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-sftp-eu-psa.pdf (pdf, 12KB)]

Thanks Kim — that answers most of our questions.

We can confirm:
- SFTP hostname: sftp-eu.alphamed-partner.eu
- Key contact: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@alphamed-partner.eu>
- We do not need on-prem connector for the pilot; hosted SFTP is fine.

Please send the DPA addendum and MAP and we'll review immediately. We also need DocuSign for the addendum to get legal sign-off by Friday (2027-10-15).

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,

Alice Chen
Information Security Manager
AlphaMed
